references.text: The same event told from Isaac's perspective; shows the fulfillment of Jacob's plan.
The preparation phase for the same event; shows Rebekah's role in creating the 'delicious dish'.
An original demand later used as a deceptive document; highlights the irony in Jacob's deception.
Repetition of Isaac's will; emphasizes how Jacob imitates his father to receive the blessing.
A direct instruction leading to the event; shows the connection between Rebekah's plan and Jacob's action.
